# S-G-3D

> Pro 3D Tactical Arena Shooter (1P/3P, Online Rooms & Solo AI Bots).

## Features

- 3 Expansive Multi-Level Tactical Arenas
- 6 Redesigned Tactical Weapons with Custom Sound Profiles
- 4 Selectable Operators with Active Combat Skills
- Dual 1st-Person (1P) & 3rd-Person (3P) Camera Perspectives
- Online Public Matchmaking, Private Custom Rooms, and Solo vs AI Bots
- Full Custom Keybinding Remapping
